text:
Mira (Docs): Tiny PR to the Dedicated provisioning guide: add a short "isolation + pinning" recipe and a migration note for renaming `tenant_hint` -> `tenant_label`. Can folks quick-check the examples and the SLA phrasing? PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/901

Jon (Eng-Platform): Paste the YAML and SDK snippets here and I'll run linkcheck + a smoke site build. Call out any new anchors you added.

Mira (Docs): YAML isolation + pinning snippets:
```yaml
isolation_policy:
  tenant_label: team-74
  eviction_tolerance: 0.02
  preemptible: false

reserved_pools:
  - name: business-hours
    models: ['rdm-large-v2']
    schedule: 'Mon-Fri:09:00-18:00'
```
JS SDK example:
```js
await client.dedicated.createPool({
  name: 'team-74-pool',
  tenant_label: 'team-74',
  min_replicas: 3,
  max_replicas: 15
});
```
Python SDK example:
```py
client.dedicated.create_pool(name='team-74-pool', tenant_label='team-74', min_replicas=3, max_replicas=15)
```
Anchors added: #isolation-policy and #operational-pinning.

Asha (Eng-ML): For eviction_tolerance please be explicit: it's the fraction of requests eligible for soft-preemptions, not a guaranteed uptime delta. Add a pointer to the Dedicated SLA table so customers understand commitments.

Liam (Eng-SRE): Suggest tweak to SLA text: replace "we will fallback" with "fallback behavior may be invoked under sustained capacity pressure; pinned reserved pools are excluded." Also add a one-line example of specifying fallback priority: `fallback_priority: ['rdm-medium-v1','rdm-small-quant-v1']`.

Mira (Docs): Updated wording and added fallback_priority one-liner. Also included a short migration snippet: `# migration: tenant_label = tenant_hint if tenant_label is None` under Upgrading SDKs.

Jon (Eng-Platform): Running linkcheck now. Found one stale ref in api-reference/routes.md mentioning `tenant_hint` inside an old example — pushed a small fix to the branch to update it. Local build shows one markdown-lint warning for line length; fixed.

ci-bot: linkcheck started for PR #901

Asha (Eng-ML): Optional: include a tiny note about monitoring signals (queue length, tail latency) that should trigger pinning or manual scale-ups. One sentence under Operational guidance is fine.

Mira (Docs): Will add a one-liner: "Monitor p95 latency and queue length; if p95 > X ms for > Y minutes consider pinning or increasing pool size." I'll add exact thresholds in follow-up when we get ops consensus.

Jon (Eng-Platform): CI: linkcheck PASS, build PASS, markdown-lint warnings: 0

Mira (Docs): Thanks — merging once green. Follow-up will add telemetry examples and the ops thresholds.
